```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
#| warning: false
phx_bg <- readRDS("g:/My Drive/Research/Phoenix park tree access/phx_bg.rds")
parks <- readRDS("g:/My Drive/Research/Phoenix park tree access/parks.rds")
phx_city_limits <- readRDS("g:/My Drive/Research/Phoenix park tree access/phx_city_limits.rds")

library(sf)
library(tidyverse)
library(tmap)
library(flextable)
```

Map Phoenix block groups with county and state inset

```{r}
#| label: fig-bg-parks
#| fig-cap: "Block groups and public parks in Phoenix, Arizona"
#| fig-alt: "A map of the locations of block groups and public parks in Phoenix, Maricopa County, Arizona"

tm_shape(phx_bg) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "lightblue",
              fill_alpha = 0.6) +
  tm_shape(phx_city_limits) +
  tm_borders(col = "black", lwd = 1.3) +
  tm_shape(parks) +
  tm_polygons(fill = "darkgreen")
```
